body:
maria: Short RFC follow-up: recommend the edge proxy own short-lived streaming leases + signed continue tokens. Gateway becomes a pass-through for tokens. Main goal: reduce resume latency and simplify gateway logic. Tradeoffs: edge statefulness, memory/IO, billing. Thoughts?
aj: Does edge also validate tokens or just issue them? How would tokens behave across multiple frontdoors?
maria: Edge issues & validates tokens. Tokens include a route_fingerprint to bind to a route set; gateways forward opaque tokens.
devon: Problem: edge crash loses in-memory leases. Options: best-effort only (no guarantees) or lightweight checkpointing to durable store so a different edge can honor resume. Checkpointing adds IO.
andre: Billing/accounting: if edge replays tokens upstream, which product/customer is billed? Need explicit attribution rules before we ship.
sre-oncall: Obs requirements: resumed sessions must link to original trace IDs and expose resume_reason. Add resume_attempts and resume_success metrics.
maria: Compromise: keep leases in-memory for hot sessions; write tiny checkpoint blobs every Xs for sessions marked replicable. Checkpoint contains session_id, route_hash, last_emitted_index, and a KV_digest pointer, not full KV.
aj: Rehydrating KV is expensive. I propose a partial-replay client contract: on resume the client re-sends the last R tokens (e.g., 128) to allow lazy KV reconstruction; upstream accepts bounded replay.
devon: Partial replay is acceptable; it's a graceful fallback. Clients must expect a short re-send of recent tokens before streaming continues.
maria: Minimal API sketch: continue_token = base64(signed{sid,route_hash,exp,flags}); resume_window=45s; replicate_interval=5s; partial_replay_tokens=128; allow_rebind=true.
andre: Security: token signing keys must rotate. Validator must accept previous keys for at least resume_window. Also scope tokens by tenant.
sre-oncall: Telemetry: resume_latency_ms histogram, resume_failure_reason tag, and trace_link. Alert if resume_success_rate < 99% for hot sessions.
devon: Memory ops: enforce per-tenant soft caps, evict via LRU, and send explicit "resume_unavailable" to client on eviction. Do not silently drop.
aj: I'll run perf sims once RFC has token size and checkpoint frequency. Targets: in-memory resume median <40ms; rebind-with-checkpoint <200ms.
maria: Action items: maria -> RFC + diagrams; aj -> perf sims; devon -> checkpoint schema + eviction policy; andre -> billing attribution; sync Wed 11:00. :thumbsup:
